svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Diode housing: turn 26 mm bar to 30 mm long. Bore 18 mm, 10 deep,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the boom; bore 12 mm through for the diode module;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: counterbore 22 mm, 4 deep, at the front for the window spigot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window: 20 mm of 26 x 22 mm clear acrylic tube, plus a 4 mm spigot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ring 22 x 18 mm solvent-welded inside each end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End cap: turn 26 mm bar to a 3 mm disc with a 4 mm spigot 22 x 18;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bond the cone mirror's stem to its centre, apex facing back.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The laser leaves the cone 300 mm in front of the dome centre:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: set this with the diode's focus and a card before bonding the cap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: boom bonded in the housing, diode clamped in its bore with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drop of silicone, window and cap bonded with clear epoxy.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a sharp, even ring on a card held round the window.
